envelope.description: Add VerificationReceipt type and a parallel RECEIPTS.md record module

body.title: Add VerificationReceipt type and a parallel RECEIPTS.md record module
body.summary: Add `VerificationReceipt` (result, environment, pass/fail outcome) and a new sibling module to src/workflow/runners/build/test-record.ts (e.g. receipt-record.ts) mirroring TestRecordCase/TestRecordReported/persistTestRecordTask/readTestRecord/renderTestRecordMd, reusing the existing writeArtifact/writeAtomic (src/workflow/storage.ts) and storeRound/withStoredModel (src/workflow/runners/build/round-writer.ts) primitives unchanged. Renders RECEIPTS.md beside the review artifact exactly as TESTS.md sits beside BUILD.md: a non-approvable RECORD, written for every sandbox/mutation checkpoint run (pass or fail), referenced by id from a corroborating SecurityFinding.
acceptanceChecks: A VerificationReceipt is written for every sandbox/mutation checkpoint run, pass or fail, independent of whether any SecurityFinding corroborates it
RECEIPTS.md renders beside the review artifact using the existing writeArtifact/writeAtomic/storeRound/withStoredModel machinery, unmodified
An approval attempt against a RECEIPTS.md/VerificationReceipt record is refused, matching TESTS.md's own non-approvable-record behavior

tests.name: VerificationReceipt record shape (pass/fail/evidence linkage by id)
RECEIPTS.md write for a security review round
